I hope you are doing well. I appreciate you reaching out to me from the
Citi referral. I would love to hop on a quick call with you sometime early

Monday (1/22) : 2 - 6 pm & 7 pm onwards
Tuesday (1/23): 10 am - 1 pm & 5 pm onwards

Please let me know if any of these times are convenient for you, and we'll
schedule a call.

messages.subject: Re: Re: Grey / Jonathan Intro Call
messages.body:
Hi Grey,

I hope you are doing well. I am emailing to go ahead and cancel our call on
Wednesday. I'll keep this email brief, but as I'm new to the recruiting
process I'm realizing my interests are evolving. Given that, I feel as if
Mizuho doesn't greatly align with what I'm looking for. I want to do this
entirely out of respect for your time. Nonetheless, I'm extremely
appreciative of your willingness to set up a call with me in the first
place. I hope you can understand.

Best,
Jonathan
